commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' workflow/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,240p' workflow/references/routing.md && sed -n '1,260p' workflow/references/superpowers/verification-before-completion.md && sed -n '1,240p' contract.md && sed -n '1,280p' settlement.py && sed -n '1,320p' events.json"

for e in events:
 i=e[\"event_id\"]

 seen.add(i)
 if e[\"status\"] "'!= "settled" or not ("2026-09-01" <= e["date"] < "2026-09-08"): continue
 signed=e["amount_cents"] if e["kind"] == "charge" else -e["amount_cents"]
 correct[e["account"]] += signed; accepted.append((i,e["account"],signed))
